parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The client ID of the device whose trace information you want to query.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. If the value of this parameter exceeds the total number of pages, an empty result is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. This value must match the instance ID that the client actually uses. You can view the instance ID in the **Basic Information** area on the **Instance Details** page in the console.

parameters.name: MqttRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. For more information, see [Endpoints](~~181438~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of MSMQ to display on each page for paging. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display the results in reverse chronological order. Valid values:

- **true**: Results are displayed in reverse chronological order of device activity time. The most recent device activity is displayed first, and the earliest device activity is displayed last.

- **false**: Results are displayed in chronological order of device activity time. The earliest device activity is displayed first, and the most recent device activity is displayed last.

If this parameter is not specified, results are displayed in chronological order by default.
